authoritative_for: Pratica owns integration, track, negotiation, offer, assent, agreement, review, attempt, exact-source-basis, caller-ingress receipt, and domain-success records for its local protocol.
not_authoritative_for: Entrants and stewards author terms, target products retain implementation and behavioral authority, and Nucleus owns agent admission and execution only.

covers: All supported public Pratica CLI outcomes for negotiation, agreement inspection, installation and diagnosis, and product development in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, target-system mutation, automatic system discovery, direct SQLite access, implementation work, release gating, and current runtime readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: Pratica surfaces are local-user CLI operations; top-level documents may be borrowed files or exact standard input, and model-assisted entries disclose only explicitly frozen bounded sources through immutable managed tools.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Pratica and correlated Nucleus state may retain private exact terms, normalized manifest descriptors, source snapshots, prompts, citations, and reviews; raw TOML transport is not retained, body-free discovery omits contract bodies and canonical source origins, and release bundles and logs retain none of those bodies.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes; entry contracts, database schema, source formats, and immutable toolset identities remain separate compatibility axes.
operational_limits: Pratica is a short-lived local CLI with bounded frozen sources and one-attempt model jobs; it is not a daemon, scheduler, crawler, policy engine, implementation agent, or release gate.
